thesis: The single most valuable conversion mechanism on this site is the coverage-check funnel, which is being bled by a dead-end /pricing page and a homepage with competing primary CTAs that dilute the visitor's next step. Fixing the /pricing error and consolidating CTAs to a single 'CHECK COVERAGE' action will recover the most revenue.

findings.title: Lab LCP of 46.4 s on mobile
findings.summary: Measured in a lab load: the page's main content takes this long to appear on a mid-range phone; most visitors have bounced long before.
findings.problem: Measured in a lab load: the page's main content takes this long to appear on a mid-range phone; most visitors have bounced long before.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse (mobile emulation, single synthetic run via DataForSEO): Largest Contentful Paint 46.4 s against a ‘good’ threshold of 2500ms. Lab data, not real-user field data — confirms the defect class, not the field percentile.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 2.0-8.0% relative lift

findings.title: Competing primary CTAs
findings.summary: Multiple primary CTAs without hierarchy confuse the visitor about which action advances the funnel.
findings.problem: Multiple primary CTAs without hierarchy confuse the visitor about which action advances the funnel.
findings.recommended_change: h1: Reliable Unlimited Internet That Works Anywhere in the U.S.; cta: CHECK COVERAGE; notes: Consolidate to one primary CTA; demote others.
findings.evidence: 7 distinct calls to action compete on the same page: “CHECK COVERAGE”, “CHECK IF IT WORKS AT MY ADDRESS”, “SEE MY OPTIONS”, “GET STARTED”, “START CHAT”, “SEE WHAT I QUALIFY FOR”, “CHECK MY COVERAGE”.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 1.0-5.0% relative lift

findings.title: Headline omits unlimited promise
findings.summary: The hero headline fails to mention unlimited data, weakening the core value proposition.
findings.problem: The hero headline fails to mention unlimited data, weakening the core value proposition.
findings.recommended_change: h1: Reliable Unlimited Internet That Works Anywhere in the U.S.; notes: Add 'unlimited' to headline.
findings.evidence: The page's main headline reads “Reliable Internet That Works Anywhere in the U.S”. | The page's main headline reads “Internet That Just Works”.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 1.0-5.0% relative lift

findings.title: Lab CLS of 0.73 on mobile
findings.summary: Measured in a lab load: the layout jumps while loading, causing mis-taps on the very buttons the funnel depends on.
findings.problem: Measured in a lab load: the layout jumps while loading, causing mis-taps on the very buttons the funnel depends on.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse (mobile emulation, single synthetic run via DataForSEO): Cumulative Layout Shift 0.73 against a ‘good’ threshold of 0.1. Lab data, not real-user field data — confirms the defect class, not the field percentile.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 1.0-5.0% relative lift

findings.title: Lab TBT of 1,140 ms on mobile
findings.summary: Measured in a lab load: script work freezes the main thread, so taps and scrolls go dead during load.
findings.problem: Measured in a lab load: script work freezes the main thread, so taps and scrolls go dead during load.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse (mobile emulation, single synthetic run via DataForSEO): Total Blocking Time 1,140 ms against a ‘good’ threshold of 200ms. Lab data, not real-user field data — confirms the defect class, not the field percentile.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 1.0-5.0% relative lift

findings.title: Review count and recency missing
findings.summary: Social proof lacks review count and recency, weakening credibility.
findings.problem: Social proof lacks review count and recency, weakening credibility.
findings.recommended_change: notes: Display review count and date range.
findings.evidence: A section heading reads “Real Stories from Real Users”. | A section heading reads “As Featured In:”.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift

findings.title: Dead-end pricing page error
findings.summary: The /pricing page returns an error, causing a dead end for users seeking pricing information.
findings.problem: The /pricing page returns an error, causing a dead end for users seeking pricing information.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 2.0-8.0% relative lift

findings.title: Funnel restarts on every page
findings.summary: The same qualification form appears on multiple pages, forcing users to re-enter the funnel regardless of landing point.
findings.problem: The same qualification form appears on multiple pages, forcing users to re-enter the funnel regardless of landing point.
findings.recommended_change: h1: What Best Describes Your Time on the Road?; cta: CONTINUE; notes: Persist progress across pages.
findings.evidence: The page's main headline reads “What Best Describes Your Time on the Road?”. | The page's main headline reads “How Do You Use the Internet at Home?”.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 1.0-5.0% relative lift

findings.title: Multiple forms with identical submit
findings.summary: Two forms with the same CONTINUE label create ambiguity about the current step.
findings.problem: Two forms with the same CONTINUE label create ambiguity about the current step.
findings.recommended_change: cta: CHECK COVERAGE / SEE MY OPTIONS; notes: Differentiate labels or add step indicators.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift

findings.title: Value claims lack specifics
findings.summary: The claim of being fastest lacks concrete speed or comparison figures, leaving the value proposition unsupported.
findings.problem: The claim of being fastest lacks concrete speed or comparison figures, leaving the value proposition unsupported.
findings.recommended_change: notes: Add measurable speed or comparison.
findings.evidence: A section heading reads “The Fastest Rural & On-the-Go Internet in the USA”. | A section heading reads “Nomad Internet: The Go-To For Rural Internet”.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift
